health.legal_basis: HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR Part 164) treatment, payment, operations
health.notes: Use for treatment lawful under HIPAA TPO; combine with minimum-necessary standard.

genetic.legal_basis: GINA Title I; HIPAA Privacy Rule
genetic.notes: Treatment use lawful; underwriting / employment use prohibited.

ethnicity.legal_basis: Section 1557 ACA; HHS Office of Minority Health
ethnicity.notes: Race / ethnicity widely collected to detect disparities. Use as a clinical-decision feature requires careful justification (the Optum / Obermeyer 2019 case is the canonical cautionary tale).

gender.notes: Clinical relevance often justifies use; Section 1557 prohibits sex discrimination in healthcare programs.

age.notes: Clinically relevant; ADEA does not apply to healthcare delivery.

disability.legal_basis: ADA Title III; Section 504 Rehabilitation Act; Section 1557 ACA

religion.notes: Pastoral / dietary relevance; otherwise not clinically justified.
